description: Codex structured review output schema. Used with codex exec --output-schema. This is intentionally a restricted subset of the canonical schema at dev-review/scripts/review_schema.json (which adds P0, info, and suggested_fix). Codex output passes through review_publish.py for final validation.

verdict.description: approve when no issues, request_changes when P1/P2 found, comment otherwise.

summary.description: Short prose summary of the review findings.

issues.description: List of review findings. Empty array for clean reviews.

path.description: Relative file path where the issue was found. Omit if not file-specific.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit if not applicable.
